With the default Sofatap preset, one finger moves the pointer and a tap left-clicks. Double-tap the left half for a double left click, or the right half for a double right click. Hold for 300 ms and move to drag. Use two fingers or the strip inside the right edge to scroll. Open Gestures to customize these actions or practice without controlling a device.

On supported computer fields, typing, selection, deletion and dictation sync live; the arrow becomes a checkmark. Otherwise, compose a draft and tap the arrow to send. In draft mode, keyboard backspace edits only the phone draft; use the small backspace button to delete on the computer. If editing pauses, check the computer field before reading it again.

Tap the microphone to start dictation and tap again to finish. Recognition and audio processing depend on your installed speech provider.

In directional remote mode, swipe up, down, left or right to move TV focus. Tap to confirm; tap with two fingers to go back. Back and Home are in the lower-right corner; swipe that small area for directional buttons. Keyboard and microphone stay in the same positions.

Native navigation requires the receiver’s TV Remote connection. Choose Connect TV remote in device options and enter the TV code. Pointer mode is separate and requires receiver and app support; its gestures can be customized in Gestures. Use directional mode for apps such as YouTube and Netflix when pointer clicks do not work.

For text, enable and select the Sofatap keyboard on the TV, then focus a normal text field. Type or dictate on the phone, then tap the arrow to send. Tap the microphone again to finish dictation. The small backspace and Enter buttons act on the TV field. Protected fields are unavailable. This preview does not guarantee every TV or app.
